Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunshine Window Treatments, LLC specializes in the design, installation, and maintenance of custom window treatments and blinds for residential and commercial properties. Our services include a wide range of window covering options such as shades, shutters, and draperies, tailored to meet the unique aesthetic and functional needs of our clients. We are committed to quality craftsmanship and ensure that all installation work is performed by our certified and trained personnel in compliance with industry safety standards. We utilize licensed subcontractors when necessary, ensuring they carry their own liability insurance. Our operations also adhere to regulations prohibiting the installation of lead-containing window treatments, thereby prioritizing the safety and health of our clients. Our secure inventory management practices and meticulous handling during installation help mitigate risks of theft and damage, allowing us to deliver outstanding service with peace of mind.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, a minor incident occurred during the installation of custom blinds at a residential property. The cause was an employee accidentally damaging a window frame while attempting to secure a blind, resulting in repair costs amounting to $2,500. The claim was promptly processed and is currently closed.
